ForgeAI

An AI product studio that turns a plain-English app idea into a working starter codebase. Dissertation project

Mood2Market

A Bitcoin sentiment and price forecasting system. FinBERT scores GDELT news and Reddit posts, then PyTorch models (a stacked LSTM and a TCN) forecast BTC price against an ARIMA baseline, all served through a live Streamlit dashboard. In a three-model bake-off the stacked LSTM reached 63.9% directional accuracy, 18.7 points above the ARIMA baseline.

Local voice AI

Jarvis

An end-to-end voice assistant built in Python: wake word, speech-to-text, LLM reasoning and speech back, with recognition running locally for privacy and zero cost. Agentic tool-calling lets it carry out real OS actions from plain speech, including volume and media control, launching apps and websites, weather, timers, screenshots and dictation, with a salvage-and-retry layer that recovers from malformed model output. It runs on a real-time audio pipeline (a shared 16 kHz mic stream, voice-activity capture, pre-roll anti-clipping and echo suppression) and a concurrent Tkinter voice-orb UI driven by a live TTS amplitude envelope.
